item.title: Top 12 Methods to Solve the 'exec user process caused exec format error' in Docker
item.description:
When you encounter the error:

standard_init_linux.go:178: exec user process caused "exec format error"

while running a specific Docker container, it can be quite frustrating. This error typically occurs when there’s a mismatch between the architecture of the container image and the host machine. Here’s a deep dive into this issue along with practical solutions to resolve it.

What Causes the “exec format error”?

This error may arise for several reasons:

  1. Mismatched architecture (e.g., running an x86 image on an ARM64 host).
  2. A container built on Apple’s M1 Pro chip targeting ARM64 architecture while running on an x86 machine.
  3. Incorrect shebang (#!) used in script files.
  4. The presence of Windows line endings in script files.
  5. Incorrect settings in the Dockerfile or build processes.
